units.body:

Prepare the personal commit skill and project release policy

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Preserve retrieved original intent and remove unconditional co-author attribution.
- [ ] Provide a self-contained user-level SKILL.md with installation/checksum/conflict instructions.
- [ ] Remove the generated repo-discovered copy and retain non-discovered reinstall source.
- [ ] Validate skill scenarios and safe installer behavior in temporary directories.
- [ ] Parent verifies actual mini user-level installation, single active skill and unrelated-repository dry-run.
- [ ] Use stable issue markers and immutable work tags without duplicate creates.

Version impact: none.

Source: contrib/commit-skill. Project policy: docs/releases/policy.md.
